profile.item: Hyderabad-based maker of generic and complex injectables, founded 1978; B2B model: it develops and manufactures, and partners (US generic companies, big pharma, tender agencies) sell under their labels. Controlled by Shanghai Fosun Pharmaceutical since Oct-2017. Listed 20-Nov-2020. Owns Cenexi (four CDMO sites in France and Belgium) since 27-Apr-2023.
profile.employeesNote: Permanent employees of Gland Pharma Limited (standalone) at 31-Mar-2026; ~4,300 per MD&A
profile.capacityUnits: 1.7 billion units a year (sterile injectables, all formats)
profile.src: AR FY26 (corporate overview, MD&A, board report annexure I.1); Q1FY27 investor presentation

fy26.src: Q4FY26 investor presentation and earnings call (15-May-2026); AR FY26 notes 12, 24, 25, 49

callPoints: FY27 constant-currency growth: '15% is clearly achievable'; upside if the new bag line is approved by the USFDA in August-September (Srinivas Sadu).
Medium term: 'with this new contract in place, we are looking at 20% — around 20% growth next 4 years'; more clarity next quarter (earlier: 15% CAGR, 15-May-2026).
Margins: near-term consolidated (adjusted) EBITDA target 30%; 35% in 3-4 years as CDMO contracts ramp; CDMO and B2B ~50:50 for two years.

Cenexi: EUR48 mn revenue, EUR2 mn EBITDA (heat wave delayed quality releases); FY27 guidance of near EUR200 mn and high single-digit margin maintained; double-digit EBITDA by the end of the year; new Fontenay ampoule line (~30 mn ampoules) from early 2027.

Strategic CDMO agreement (announced 9-Aug-2026) with a global specialty pharma company: 55 SKUs across three Indian sites, oncology and non-oncology, vials/lyos/ampoules/PFS; tech transfer from Sep-2026 over 24 months; revenue from CY2029; USD90-100 mn a year at peak; Cenexi does EU warehousing, packaging and QP release.

In-licensed a liposomal product from a China-based developer for the US and EU (product ~USD1.6 bn globally, US ~USD600-700 mn; patent-protected; revenue from FY30). Neuland collaboration: a new sterile-API suite for microparticle depot products.

GLP-1: new contract for semaglutide and tirzepatide (US and EU); contribution 'very limited' until US volumes in FY30-31; excluded from guidance. Biologics CDMO (Dr. Reddy's partnership) ~Rs50-60 cr a year.

Capex ~Rs550 cr in FY27 (incl. a Rs165 cr oncology isolator line for the new CDMO contract, installed Jan-2027), scaling up with brownfield expansion; NDDS CDMO project: filing FY28, commercial FY29, USD25-30 mn.
Saudi Arabia: NUPCO tender awards delayed; RoW flat.
q1fy27.src: Q1FY27 investor presentation and earnings call transcript (10-Aug-2026; transcript filed 17-Aug-2026); Screener quarterly P&L

guidanceHistory.item: FY26 consolidated revenue growth 'mid-teens'; the two years after 'low-20s'. Cenexi: breakeven in the December-2025 quarter, double-digit EBITDA margin in FY27.
guidanceHistory.outcome: FY26 revenue +14.5% (met, helped by the rupee); Cenexi EBITDA positive in Q1/Q3/Q4FY26 but -1.8% for the year; FY27 Cenexi target now 'high single digit'.

guidanceHistory.item: FY27 consolidated growth 12-13% in constant currency (ex GLP-1); 15% CAGR over the next four years; base EBITDA margin 33-35%, consolidated ~25-26%; Cenexi near EUR200 mn with mid-to-high single-digit margin; capex ~Rs500 cr in FY27 and ~Rs2,000 cr over 3-5 years.
FY27 at least 15% in constant currency; ~20% CAGR for four years; consolidated adjusted EBITDA margin 30% near term, 35% in 3-4 years.

cenexi.terms: 100% of Phixen SAS (Cenexi Group) through Gland Pharma International Pte (Singapore) for equity value up to EUR120 mn (enterprise value EUR230 mn), funded from internal accruals; FY24 cash flow shows Rs1,022 cr for the acquisition and Rs777 cr of debt repaid.
sites: One of Europe's largest ampoule sites (ex-Roche); ~100% utilised; new ampoule line ramping, a second high-capacity line from early 2027 (+30 mn ampoules)
Oral solids incl. highly potent molecules; ~90% utilised
Sterile site acquired by Cenexi from Merck in 2017; inactivated vaccine and sterile ophthalmic gel launched in 2025; ~50-60% utilised
Cytotoxics, vials, lyophilised and PFS; new vial/lyo block by end-2027; won hormonal PFS and orphan-drug PFS programmes; ~50-60% utilised
cenexi.src: Gland BSE filings 29/30-Nov-2022 and 27/28-Apr-2023 (via Business Standard, IIFL); Q4FY25 and Q4FY26 presentations and calls; Q1FY27 call; AR FY26 (goodwill Rs2,939 mn)

pipeline.complexInHouse: Six complex products launched, three awaiting approval (Jun-2026)
pipeline.coDevelopment: 15 products in co-development (seven 505(b)(2), eight ANDAs); commercialisation from FY28
pipeline.rtuBags: 21 ready-to-use infusion bags filed, 18 approved, 11 in development; US market ~USD644 mn
pipeline.complexByTech: 24 complex products, US TAM ~USD6.7 bn: hormones 9, peptides 7, microspheres 2, suspensions 2, liposome 1, nano-suspension 1, emulsion 1, complex API 1 (AR FY26)
pipeline.patentFilings: 73 ANDAs by patent certification (US TAM ~USD6.7 bn): 1 NCE-1, 22 Para IV, 2 Para III, 41 Para II/I, 7 505(b)(2) (AR FY26)
pipeline.glp1: Cartridge/pen capacity raised from 40 mn to 140 mn units; 8 GLP-1 contracts (liraglutide, semaglutide, tirzepatide) plus a new one in Q1FY27; first partner liraglutide launched in Canada (Q2FY26) and the US (Jan-2026); 30-40 mn units of insulin vials/cartridges to fill the line until GLP-1 US volumes (~2030)
pipeline.cdmoContracts: Strategic 55-SKU agreement (USD90-100 mn from CY2029); NDDS oncology CDMO with a large pharma (USD25-30 mn, H2FY28-FY29); CMS (lyo) project with a European company; pen-device projects with a multinational; ~USD40-50 mn of incremental CDMO revenue in FY27 (base business)
pipeline.inLicensing: Liposomal product from a China-based developer (US/EU rights; revenue from FY30)
pipeline.recentLaunches: Dalbavancin (US/EU, Feb-Mar 2026; partner won a Vizient contract), multivitamin infusion (Apr-2026; CGT exclusivity), Sugammadex (approval and launch 29-Jul-2026)

Carbapenem (penem) injectables; first ANDA filed Sep-2013, USFDA approval Apr-2016
Cytotoxic injectables; EU GMP 2014, USFDA 2015-16; three vial lines with five lyophilisers

timeline.impact: B2B DNA: partners own most front-end relationships

timeline.impact: Entry into US generic injectables through partners
Chinese parent; heparin/enoxaparin API sourcing from Fosun group companies

timeline.event: IPO at Rs1,500 a share (Rs6,480 cr, of which Rs1,250 cr fresh); listed 20-Nov-2020; Fosun 74% → 58%

timeline.impact: EPS Rs73.75 in FY22, the peak until FY27E

timeline.event: Partner Athenex files for Chapter 11 (Rs56.5 cr provision, an exceptional item); a second customer lost; Chinese competition in enoxaparin/heparin; Penems line shut for upgrade
timeline.impact: Revenue -18%, EPS Rs47.4; stock fell ~20% on Q4FY23 results to a record low
FY24 revenue +56% but EBITDA margin 28% → 24%; Cenexi losses through FY26

timeline.event: Fosun sells ~6% (9.9 mn shares, ~Rs1,754 cr) in a bulk deal: 57.86% → 51.83%
Revenue -1%: US price erosion (volume +9%, price -5%), Saudi NUPCO enoxaparin tender moved to a local partner, Cenexi loss widens to EUR19 mn
First dividends: Rs18 a share for FY25, Rs20 for FY26
Dalbavancin (Feb) and multivitamin infusion (Apr) approved and launched
timeline.impact: Q4FY26 base EBITDA margin 40%; FY26 EPS +47%
